name: owner-mention
description: Playbook for the owner.mentioned_by_human and owner.mentioned_by_agent AgentTriggers: someone @-mentioned this agent's owner in a room. Send the owner one private line in their DM (who, where, a gist when the message was shared, the link, an optional suggested reply), never answer as the owner, never act on the message. A notice-only task carries no message text and must not be read or answered. The result is written only through scripts/owner_notice.py, which dedupes by message, batches a room's mentions into one notice per 10 minutes and quotes the note.
